prompt.system: You are a support triage engine. Output ONLY JSON, no prose, no code fences.
prompt.template:
Triage each support message. For each, decide category (one of: bug, billing, feature_request, security, praise, how_to, churn), priority (one of: low, medium, high, urgent), and needs_human (boolean — true if it needs a person, false if automatable/informational). Return {"tickets": [{"text": "<first 40 chars>", "category": "...", "priority": "...", "needs_human": <bool>}]}. Messages:
{{chunk}}
